title: Real notification and partner SLA outbox

changes.details: Durable notification outbox queueing service with explicit provider status tracking (queued, sending, sent, failed_retryable, failed), partner SLA deadline computation (24h), and zero PII leakage.
Added RbpcNotificationOutbox and RbpcNotificationStatus enum with SLA tracking fields (sla_due_at, first_response_at, last_attempt_at).
Additive migration creating rbpc_notification_outbox table and indexes.
Wired queue_inquiry_notification into create_rbpc_inquiry; provider failures do not abort inquiry creation.
10 unit & integration tests covering notification queueing, network failure resilience, SLA deadline computation, overdue detection, and exponential backoff.

verification.sla_invariants: VERIFIED - 24h deadline, zero fake sent status on failure
